item.name: Get all RPO policies for an Availability Machine including service-level and database-level policies

request.name: Get all RPO policies for an Availability Machine including service-level and database-level policies

description.content:
Returns comprehensive RPO policy information for an Availability Machine, including:
- Service-level RPO policy (applies to the entire service/CDB)
- Database-level RPO policies (applies to individual databases like Oracle PDBs)

This endpoint should be used instead of the deprecated `/availability-machines/{id}/rpo-policy`
which only returns service-level RPO policy.

response.name: OK
